# SvgPageExportOptions

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Options controlling how a document page is exported to SVG.

All members have sensible defaults that produce compact, deterministic, standalone SVG.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new SvgPageExportOptions()
```

## Properties

- [`CaptureLayout`](#capturelayout): Capture a `LayoutSnapshot` of the rendered element tree (types, parent relationships, and per-page rectangles) and return it on the export result.
- [`EmbedImages`](#embedimages): How raster images should be represented.
- [`IncludeAccessibilityMetadata`](#includeaccessibilitymetadata): Include `<title>`, `role`, and `aria-label` on the root `<svg>`.
- [`MaxPages`](#maxpages): Maximum number of pages to emit.
- [`Precision`](#precision): Decimal places for generated coordinates.
- [`ShapeRendering`](#shaperendering): Value for the root `shape-rendering` attribute.
- [`Title`](#title): Human-readable document title used to build the `<title>`/`aria-label` when `IncludeAccessibilityMetadata` is set.

### `CaptureLayout`

```csharp
bool CaptureLayout { get; set; }
```

Capture a `LayoutSnapshot` of the rendered element tree (types, parent relationships, and per-page rectangles) and return it on the export result. Off by default and zero-cost when off: with no recorder attached, the layout pass is byte-identical to normal output. Used by the previewer's structure view to highlight where each element landed.

### `EmbedImages`

```csharp
SvgImageEmbedding EmbedImages { get; set; }
```

How raster images should be represented. Defaults to `DataUri`.

### `IncludeAccessibilityMetadata`

```csharp
bool IncludeAccessibilityMetadata { get; set; }
```

Include `<title>`, `role`, and `aria-label` on the root `<svg>`. This is a lightweight preview affordance, not PDF/UA structure export. Defaults to `true` (matches the TypeScript port).

### `MaxPages`

```csharp
int? MaxPages { get; set; }
```

Maximum number of pages to emit. The full document is still laid out (so pagination/overflow stays correct), but only the first `MaxPages` pages are serialized. `null` exports every page. Useful for preview/thumbnail pipelines that only need the first few pages.

### `Precision`

```csharp
int Precision { get; set; }
```

Decimal places for generated coordinates. Defaults to 3 for stable, compact output.

### `ShapeRendering`

```csharp
SvgShapeRendering ShapeRendering { get; set; }
```

Value for the root `shape-rendering` attribute. Defaults to `Auto`, which writes no attribute. Set `CrispEdges` for pages dominated by pixel-grid graphics.

### `Title`

```csharp
string Title { get; set; }
```

Human-readable document title used to build the `<title>`/`aria-label` when `IncludeAccessibilityMetadata` is set. Defaults to the document metadata title, then a generic label.
